description: Offline Colorado center-source normalization with separate postal fields, precise provider IDs and explicit address, temporal and geocode gaps.
redirect_policy: No source requests; independently verify retained inputs inside datahub.
retry: No automatic retry or source repull. Preserve acquired input for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Immutable source-linked records, quarantine and reconciled summary, independently replayed before manifest-last publication.
idempotency: Bind acquired manifest path, hash, run, mode and transformation version; preserve inputs and prior normalized releases.
cancellation: Cooperative replay and drained writes; remove only owned incomplete cancellation output and preserve uncertain publication.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates with exact selected raw provenance and licensing-application-reported physical addresses, not independently verified premises. Null geocodes; separate ZIP5 and ZIP4.
